description: The document describes the structure and functioning of a feedforward neural network. It notes that the network contains an input layer with n-dimensional vectors, L-1 hidden layers with n neurons each, and an output layer with k neurons. Each neuron has a pre-activation and activation value. The pre-activation at layer i is the weighted sum of outputs from layer i-1 plus a bias. The activation is this pre-activation passed through an activation function. Backpropagation is used to minimize a loss function through gradient descent to learn the network's weights and biases parameters. CS7015 (Deep Learning): Lecture 4.
